canonical_project: DigiCo Townsville TSV1 / North Queensland Regional Data Centre
notes: DigiCo lists Townsville TSV1 in its Asia Pacific data-centre portfolio. Data Center Map identifies it at 125-129 Dalrymple Road with 140 racks, N+1 redundancy and 1.2MW power capacity, and records the former iseek North Queensland Regional Data Centre opening in September 2019; CIO reported the original Townsville City Council/JCU NQRDC procurement plan.
